title: Music's remembered view yields to a just-connected or reconnect-needed service
acceptance: Returning to Music from a provider OAuth round-trip opens the service just connected, even when Reconnect started from a chip that was not selected.

A remembered service whose connection is expired or needs a reconnect stays selected and shows its Reconnect prompt, rather than falling back to another service; a service with no connection still falls back.
nextAction: From the RF-137 final review (#672). Feed consumeConnectionReturn's provider into MusicWorkspace and decide which connection states count as 'disconnected' for resolveMusicProvider. Agent-created: Backlog until the owner sets Ready.

evidence.summary: Final review of #672 on b9674b7 logged, not fixed: an OAuth return opens the remembered view rather than the just-connected service; an expired remembered service falls back like a disconnected one, hiding where Reconnect would show.
